verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says you can select diff lines and send feedback to a running agent session, and use Design mode to send requested changes to an agent with element context. The docs add notifications when an agent pauses for input, and automation outputs are live workspaces you can continue interactively. Together these show you can steer active sessions without restarting, with the terminal-centric model (confirmed by a user) as the general channel. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on mid-run steering of an arbitrary active session, evidence of a programmatic send-to-running-session API (CLI/SDK/MCP), and independent hands-on corroboration of steering behavior.
